title: Cape Town International's site
note: Note: Schematic, not to scale. Each component takes its status from Table 2.14. Infrastructure Report, Jul 2026, p102.
lead_in: The terminals and aircraft stands sit between the runway and the roads, and six of the seven components are full or under strain (Figure 2.17).
remarks: All seven components and their statuses are Table 2.14's; nothing on the figure comes only from the deck.

IR p102 draws five elements (runway, international terminal, domestic departures, domestic arrivals, roads and parking). Taxiways and aircraft stands is added as a band between the runway and the terminals, and airline network and routes as a tag beside the site, as the brief asks.
The schematic is turned a quarter turn from the slide (runway along the top, roads along the bottom) so that every label reads horizontally.
Callout is v15's sentence from 'Runway and terminal capacity'. The side marker reads 'Boxed in', v15's term.
